paper.title: Conflict-Averse Gradient Descent for Multi-task Learning
paper.mapping: Section 3.1, Eq. (3), Dual Objective and Algorithm 1; alpha here is paper c, not learning rate

implementation.dual: min_{w >= 0, sum(w)=1} w^T A b + alpha*||G b||*sqrt(w^T A w); A=G^T G, b=ones(T)/T
implementation.direction: d = G b + alpha*||G b||*(G w)/||G w||; zero weighted gradient contributes zero correction
implementation.solver: Installed scipy 1.15.3, SLSQP with analytic subgradient; no dependency installation
implementation.optimality: Reject unsuccessful solve, nonfinite weights/direction, simplex infeasibility, normalized KKT residual or primal-dual gap above threshold
numerical_changes_from_author: Generalize the three-task shape to arbitrary T
Use float64 CPU and common entry-scale normalization, which preserves the exact dual minimizer
Solve unsmoothed Algorithm 1 objective instead of author additive 1e-8 stabilizers; explicit zero-mean/alpha-zero cases
Supply analytic derivative, explicit tolerance, solver status and optimality checks instead of accepting res.x unconditionally
implementation.shared_parameters: Only gradients of parameters participating in all original Local/Base/Full objectives enter this shared solve; root integration owns task creation and parameter partition
implementation.nonshared_parameters: Use gradient of the equal-weight mean task loss, with zero for unused tasks; no CAGrad correction
implementation.author_sum_loss_convention: The supervised author's overwrite_grad multiplies the returned direction by three to match its sum-loss convention. This helper and the OSRAM equal-weight control use the paper mean-loss convention, so do not multiply the direction by task count
implementation.optimizer: Assign existing parameter .grad, then existing clipping and Adam; no optimizer replacement
implementation.scientific_scope: Optimization update only; does not change memory, create new scientific tasks or authorize training

verification.result: 8 unittest cases passed (including parametrized subtests); git diff --check passed
verification.tests: Independent primal max-min ball solve; aligned and alpha-zero limits; zero/mean-zero and zero task gradients; scale/task-order invariance; finite gradients and existing Adam update; rejection of failed and falsely successful nonoptimal solves
not_tested: Full trainer integration is owned by parent agent
